facts.text: The hotel is on the Paseo de la Castellana, one of the most exclusive areas in Madrid.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel is located on the Paseo de la Castellana, one of the most exclusive areas in Madrid.

facts.text: The hotel is close to Salamanca, a luxury shopping district.
facts.excerpt: in close proximity to Salamanca, a luxury shopping district

facts.text: The hotel is near the city's prestigious museums and shops.
facts.excerpt: our hotel is located near the city’s prestigious museums and shops

facts.text: The InterContinental opened in 1953 as Spain's first international luxury hotel.
facts.excerpt: The InterContinental opened in 1953 as Spain’s first international luxury hotel

facts.text: The hotel has hosted celebrities from Ava Gardner and Charlton Heston to visiting heads of state.
facts.excerpt: having hosted celebrities from Ava Gardner and Charlton Heston to visiting heads of state with security detail in tow

facts.text: The hotel has a marble-lined lobby.
facts.excerpt: 24-hour gym and an exquisite marble-lined lobby

facts.text: Live music plays in the marble-lined lobby while diners eat.
facts.excerpt: Live music in the marble-lined lobby swoons well-dressed diners

facts.text: Rooms and suites may include views of the Castellana.
facts.excerpt:
Classic Rooms may include:

- Castellana View

facts.text: The Ava Suite is a tribute to Ava Gardner, with a terrace overlooking Paseo de la Castellana.
facts.excerpt: Experience the luxurious Signature Suite, a tribute to Ava Gardner, with 97 m² and a 20 m² terrace overlooking Paseo de la Castellana.

facts.text: The Royal Suite has a terrace with views of the Madrid skyline.
facts.excerpt: The 220m² terrace offers breathtaking views of the Madrid skyline.

facts.text: The Royal Suite has a living room, a private dining room, a kitchenette and a bath designed by Philippe Starck.
facts.excerpt: It features a spacious living room, a private dining room, a kitchenette, and a cozy bedroom with a large dressing room and a Philippe Starck-designed luxury bath.

facts.text: Club InterContinental gives suite guests an independent reception and a private buffet breakfast.
facts.excerpt: Our excellent Guest Relations team will offer you premium personalized services, such as an independent reception, private buffet breakfast and much more.

facts.text: The second-floor Club InterContinental lounge overlooks the sidewalks below, with complimentary meals and evening drinks.
facts.excerpt: the second-floor Club InterContinental lounge where complimentary meals and evening drinks flow freely overlooking the bustling sidewalks below

facts.text: The 24/7 Fitness Studio has Technogym equipment, with Pilates and yoga classes.
facts.excerpt: Transform your fitness routine with our 24/7 Fitness Studio, featuring premium Technogym equipment. Personalize your workouts with tailored sessions or invigorating Pilates and yoga classes.

facts.text: Treatments include massages, facials and a Swedish sauna.
facts.excerpt: indulge in bespoke treatments, including relaxing massages, revitalizing facials, and our authentic Swedish sauna.

facts.text: At El Jardin restaurant, Chef Miguel de la Fuente cooks traditional Spanish cuisine with international influences.
facts.excerpt: At El Jardin restaurant, our Chef Miguel de la Fuente designs delicious recipes of traditional Spanish cuisine with international influences.

facts.text: The Sunday Brunch offers more than 200 dishes, with live music and a pastry master class for kids.
facts.excerpt: Experience live music and a pastry master class for kids, ensuring a remarkable dining experience for everyone.

facts.text: The outdoor El Jardin terrace is open from spring through autumn and has a lounge area with wine and tapas in a tropical garden.
facts.excerpt: An extension of Bar 49, the lounge area of El Jardin Terrace is a place to relax and unwind with a glass of wine amongst a selection of tapas in our tropical garden.
